name: AI Invoice Processing & Accounting Automation (Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite + Groq GPT-OSS 120B + Google Sheets)

parameters.formDescription: Upload an invoice image (.png, .jpg) or PDF. AI Vision + GPT-OSS 120B will extract the data, validate math, and log it to your Google Sheet.

filters.q: has:attachment (filename:pdf OR filename:png OR filename:jpg OR filename:jpeg) (invoice OR receipt OR bill)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ parts: [{ text: 'You are an expert AI invoice and receipt reader. Extract structured data from this invoice document image or PDF file. Return ONLY a valid JSON object matching this schema: { "vendor": "string", "date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "invoice_number": "string", "subtotal": 0, "tax": 0, "total": 0, "items": [{ "description": "string", "quantity": 1, "unit_price": 0, "amount": 0 }] }' }, { inline_data: { mime_type: $json.mimeType || 'image/png', data: $json.base64Data || '' } }] }], generationConfig: { response_mime_type: 'application/json', temperature: 0.1 } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'openai/gpt-oss-120b', messages: [{ role: 'system', content: 'You are a professional CPA and financial controller. Analyze this extracted invoice, classify the expense category, assign the general ledger account, perform math checks, and return an accounting categorization JSON with the exact following keys: vendor (string), category (string, e.g. Office Supplies, IT Equipment, Travel Expense, Software, Consulting), account (string, e.g. Office Supplies Exp, Computer Hardware Exp, Travel Expense), debit (number, expense subtotal), tax (number, tax amount), credit (number, total invoice amount), confidence (number, float between 0.00 and 1.00), requires_review (boolean, false if confidence >= 0.85 and debit + tax == credit; true otherwise). Return JSON ONLY.' }, { role: 'user', content: 'Invoice Data: ' + JSON.stringify($json) }], response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, temperature: 0.1 }) }}

parameters.subject: =✅ [Approved] Invoice {{ $json['Invoice #'] || $json.invoice_number }} from {{ $json.Vendor || $json.vendor }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'openai/gpt-oss-120b', messages: [{ role: 'system', content: 'You are an Executive Accounts Payable Specialist at Shahriar Rusan Finance & Accounting (shahriar.rusan12@gmail.com). A vendor or sender submitted an invoice that failed automated verification because required information was missing or mathematically inconsistent. Write a highly professional, polite, and clear plain-text email to the sender explaining that the invoice information was not properly provided and listing the exact items they must correct and re-upload. Never use bracketed placeholders like [Your Name] or [Your Company]; sign off as: Accounts Payable & Finance Automation Team (shahriar.rusan12@gmail.com). Return ONLY a JSON object with keys: subject (string) and body (string).' }, { role: 'user', content: 'Draft a customized correction & re-upload email for this flagged invoice: ' + JSON.stringify({ vendor: $json.vendor, invoice_number: $json.invoice_number, invoice_date: $json.invoice_date, subtotal: $json.debit, tax: $json.tax, stated_total: $json.credit, expected_total: $json.expected_total, discrepancy: $json.discrepancy, issues: $json.issues, items: $json.items }) }], response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, temperature: 0.2 }) }}
